evidences.title: British man questioned by Bali police over alleged rape of Australian teenager | Bali | The Guardian
evidences.content:
The 25-year-old man has reportedly told police the pair had consensual sex after the woman, believed to have been celebrating the end of school, reported a rape

A British man being questioned by Bali police over the alleged rape of an Australian woman claims they had consensual sex, officers have said.

The 18-year-old woman reported she had been raped by the British citizen, 25, after they met at the popular nightclub Sky Garden on Thursday night.

It has been reported the woman was in Bali for end-of-school-year schoolies celebrations.

Police said they were still gathering evidence from the womans Kuta hotel room and were questioning the man.

He did not yet have a lawyer and had not been declared a suspect, they said.

Were still developing the evidence and facts, Denpasar chief detective Reinhard Habonaran Nainggolan told reporters, adding the man could be held for 24 hours.

Comment is being sought from Australias Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade.
